document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The cold blast did not hurt Bernard as badly as you feared. 
Helped  to  the  shelter  of  a  nearby  glade,  he  warms  up  and 
recovers his strength. You can explore further. But can you risk 
the return of the mysterious flying being?
To explore the valley, go to 645. To leave it, go to 613.
